sources.title: Home - PaddleOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 is a new iterative version of the PaddleOCR-VL series. Based on comprehensive optimization of the core capabilities of version 1.0, the model achieves 94.5% accuracy on the authoritative document parsing benchmark OmniDocBench v1.5, surpassing top global general-purpose large models and document parsing-specific models.

sources.snippet: PaddleOCR-VL — Vision-language model for document parsing. Uses PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 (0.9B parameters) to achieve 96.33% accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.6 — SOTA for open-source document AI. PP-ChatOCRv4 — Conversational document understanding. Chat with your PDFs and images using natural language queries backed by PaddleOCR's extraction pipeline.
